name: Velvet React
source:
A.S. 216.
Climate change and chaotic world events have caused drastic changes to the world map, 
Resulting in massive exoduses, food shortages, and a severe energy crisis. 
Amid this disaster, "humanoids" emerged.
Humanoids possess a function that other robots do not.

A system that could "transform proteins created by the human body into energy"—

The evolution of humanoids has been extraordinary. They improved day by day, and soon took up positions in various fields.

Special Organization Ord -the security institution established in association with the military, the police, and civilians.
The Organization has allowed a humanoid to be recruited into their ranks.

The name of that recruit is "Walter".

Walter and his companions must face the many challenges within the floating city of KANTO.
In a turbulent world, how will the story of "humans" and "humanoids" unfold—

[from [url=https://www.ero-labs.com/en/game.html?id=39]EroLabs[/url]]

End Of Service on Erolabs: Jun 09, 2025

Revival on Dokiringo: Feb 17, 2026
translation:
作为。216.
气候变化和混乱的世界事件导致世界地图发生剧变，
导致大规模人口外流、粮食短缺和严重的能源危机。
在这场灾难中，“类人生物”出现了。
类人机器人拥有其他机器人所没有的功能。

一个可以“将人体产生的蛋白质转化为能量”的系统——

类人生物的进化非同寻常。他们一天天进步，很快就在各个领域担任职务。

特别组织令——与军队、警察和平民联合建立的安全机构。
该组织允许招募一个人形生物加入他们的队伍。

这名新兵的名字是“沃尔特”。

沃尔特和他的同伴必须面对漂浮城市关东的诸多挑战。
动荡的世界，“人类”与“类人生物”的故事将如何展开——

[来自[url=https://www.ero-labs.com/en/game.html?id=39]EroLabs[/url]]
